title: iocs.scan
description: Scan case evidence against indicators of compromise (YARA rules or Sigma logs). Returns structured match records with severity classification.

case_id.description: UUID v4 case identifier from case.open.

ruleset.description: IOC ruleset to apply. yara_default=SIFT bundled, yara_custom=user-supplied, sigma=log detection rules.

target_glob.description: Optional glob pattern relative to case sandbox (no leading / or ..). If omitted, scans entire sandbox.

inputSchema.description: Case and ruleset required; target glob optional (defaults to entire sandbox).

scan_id.description: UUID v4 scan run identifier. Links results to execution context.

rule.description: Name of matched rule or detection signature.

path.description: Relative path within sandbox where match occurred.

offset.description: Byte offset of match within file (0 if not applicable).

context.description: Optional brief context snippet (first 256 bytes around match).

matches.description: Array of IOC matches. Empty if no hits.

tool_used.description: SIFT tool that performed the scan.

outputSchema.description: Scan results with structured matches and execution metadata.

x-mcp-capability.name: iocs.scan
x-mcp-capability.description: Scan case evidence against YARA/Sigma IOC rules.
constraints: target_glob must be sandbox-relative; no leading / or .. allowed
Only yara and sigma subprocess calls permitted
All matches must include sandbox-relative paths
No shell access; glob expansion only via whitelisted tools
Output must be structured JSON with severity classification
